persons.name: Vīrabāhādura
persons.evidence: līkhitaṃ nepāla yela akavāhālayā śrīvīravāhādura śākevaṃśa kuti nāma desasa conā vale dharmmacitta utapati juyā va ... coyā sidhayakā viyā jula

persons.name: Narasiṃha
persons.evidence: yela desa kvavāhāla cāla dhālāsika sa conahma (++++++++++)narasiṃha va kṛṣṇalālaśreṣṭhayāta thva śrīaṣṭasāhaśrikāprajñāpāramitāyā purāna poṣṭaka nepālabhṣānaṃ coyā sidhayakā viyā jula

persons.name: Kṛṣṇalāla
persons.evidence: kṛṣṇalālaśreṣṭhayāta thva śrīaṣṭasāhaśrikāprajñāpāramitāyā purāna poṣṭaka nepālabhṣānaṃ coyā sidhayakā viyā jula

date.as_written: vikramasaṃvat 1973 subhasamvat 1037 sāla miti phālguṇakṛṣṇa ṣaṣṭhami(!) visāṣāḍhā nakṣatra harṣana(!) yoga galakarṇa (!) vṛścikrāsi buddhavāra

purpose: dharmmacitta utapati juyā va ... thugu dharmmadānapati sahita jagatasaṃsāra uddhāra juyamāla jula
notes: The scribe Vīrabāhādura Śākya of Hakhabāhāl (Patan) completed the manuscript while residing in Kuti (Tibet) and gifted it to [lacuna]narasiṃha and Kṛṣṇalāla Śreṣṭha of Kvavāhāl (Patan). Both VS 1973 and NS 1037 are recorded.
